snippet.title: The Last Samurai 2 (2026) | Tom Cruise, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Bryan Cranston | Concept Trailer
snippet.description:
#TheLastSamurai2 #tomcruise #concepttrailer 

Watch This The Last Samurai 2 Concept Trailer

What if Nathan Algren never truly left Japan and twenty-two years after the fall of the samurai, the warrior code he swore to honor called him back to fight one last time? This fan-made concept trailer imagines The Last Samurai 2 for 2026 where Tom Cruise returns as Algren, living in exile deep in the mountains of Japan, haunting a quiet village and carrying the memory of Katsumoto until a ruthless imperial general named Takeda Hiroshi played by Bryan Cranston launches a campaign to erase every remaining samurai bloodline and seize ancestral lands for industrial expansion. I personally created every storyboard and visual in this "What If" concept from scratch, building a sequel where Arnold Schwarzenegger plays Colonel Elias Crane, an American arms dealer who supplies Takeda with devastating Gatling guns and modern weapons, turning a cultural purge into an industrial slaughter that shatters Algren's seclusion when a neighboring village is burned to the ground and its people massacred before his eyes.

Emily Blunt plays Akemi, Katsumoto's fierce granddaughter and a self-taught swordswoman who carries her grandfather's blade but distrusts the foreigner who claims to have loved his ways, and her reluctant alliance with Algren becomes the emotional core of a story about legacy, grief, and the cost of keeping a dying code alive. Every visual in this HD concept trailer was designed and built by me to honor the breathtaking cinematography and emotional weight of the original Last Samurai while pushing the saga into a desperate final stand at an ancient mountain fortress where scattered ronin trained by Algren and Akemi face Takeda's advancing army and Crane's Gatling guns in a battle that tests the resistance to its breaking point. This Last Samurai 2 concept trailer ends with Algren defeating Takeda in single combat on a rain-soaked mountainside, Akemi holding her grandfather's blade upright at the gate wounded but unbroken, and the ronin who came back to fight one last time walking alone into the mountains once more, disappearing into the landscape that made him because some warriors are not meant to be remembered but to simply endure.

Disclaimer: This is entirely a fan-made concept trailer created for entertainment and creative purposes only. All storyboard work and visuals were originally created by me. This video is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Warner Bros., or any official The Last Samurai production or its rights holders.

the pay is low but I gotta do something

I’ll see you on the other side

Building future ruins

above the law like good little puppet

I’m gonna stay alive
I’m climbing out through the window

I’m gonna meet you there

More about Paralives (from Steam):

Hop on, we’re leaving, and your new life awaits! Paralives is a sandbox life simulation game with a great cast of Townies to meet, as well as a vibrant open-world town to explore and make your own. You will feel right at home, should you choose to embark.

What kind of life will you build?
Whether you focus on your career, finding love, building a family, or becoming the richest person in town, the story is yours to write in Paralives. But twists and forks in the road await. What will you leave behind?

You live and then you die. At least, do it in a nice house!
Thanks to an ever-evolving catalog of furniture, decor and clutter objects, staging the perfect homes for your Parafolks will be a breeze: resize, recolor, stack and place items freely for a tactile building experience.

Paralives allows truly grid-less constructions with curved walls, split-level floors and more. Recreating your house or building an intricate 8-story mansion has never been this easy.

There are lives to create and stories to tell
You will be handed an advanced character creator called the Paramaker. Adjust the height of your Parafolks, tweak a wide array of facial and body features, design stylish outfits and create complex personalities. From head to toe, no small detail will be left out!

Key features
🏡 Explore an open-world town filled with shops, parks, restaurants and museums
👕 Create Parafolks of all looks and styles
💼 Find a job and try out flexible career progression paths
🧠 Discover unique personality traits, skills, wants, needs and emotions
❤️ Find love and make friends, or enemies
👨‍👩‍👦 Multiselect Parafolks and do anything as a group
👵 Grow up, have children and live a long life
🔨 Enjoy the customization and flexibility of our house-building tools
⚙️ Experiment with our in-game modding interface to edit or add content to the game
💌 Find community-made mods, houses and Parafolks through the Steam Workshop


More features and content will be added during Early Access and after through exclusively free updates, as we have pledged to our community.

To be added during the Early Access phase
Weather and seasons
Dogs, cats and horses
Cars and bikes
Boats and houseboats
Pools and swimming
Calendar and organizing social events (parties, weddings)
Story progression for NPCs
Family tree
Gardening and fishing
Tools to edit and create towns
More personality traits, wants, emotions, jobs, etc

snippet.title: Garden of Hopes and Dreams (DELTARUNE Chapter 5) - Official Performance Video
snippet.description:
I had the absolute pleasure of contributing a song to the soundtrack of DELTARUNE Chapter 5! "Garden of Hopes and Dreams" is based on my arrangement of "Field of Hopes and Dreams" from Deltarune Chapter 1 (composed by Toby Fox) from 2018. I was asked by Toby to use this song in Chapter 5, and I decided to update the arrangement a bit to fit better in-game. Never in a million years would I have imagined that my arrangement from 2018 would eventually find its way to being featured in-game (especially in such a beautiful area!) so I'm just super grateful to have had this opportunity! I hope you can enjoy spotting the differences between this new and the old arrangements! 

If you're someone who has listened to my original 2018 arrangement of this song, thank you so much. It means so much to me to have this song included in DELTARUNE Chapter 5, and I hope that you all can feel all the love and passion that went into making both my original 2018 arrangement, and this new arrangement. Thank you so much for your continued support! 

DELTARUNE: https://deltarune.com/
DELTARUNE Chapter 5 OST: https://tobyfox.bandcamp.com/album/deltarune-chapter-5-original-game-soundtrack
My 2018 arrangement of "Field of Hopes and Dreams": https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kSU0w7KwRIw

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Kowakujo World's First Nyxara Easter Egg Ending Cutscene! (Black Ops 7 Zombies DLC 4)
snippet.description:
Kowakujo World's First Nyxara Easter Egg Boss Fight + Ending Cutscene! Yggdrasil Reborn! (Black Ops 7 Zombies DLC 4)

Congrats to Flame_150 for apparent world's first https://x.com/Flame_150/status/2071060797355127108
FYI, regarding the Kowakujo "world's first". As far as I'm aware, it wasn't cheated. They were in a 7+ hour game and they managed to luckily find the super random step everyone was stuck on. The rest wasn't as random. If it's revealed later that they cheated, then fair, but right now it's just accusations. I know the directed mode steps leaked but as far as I'm aware they haven't seem them. They'll share what they recorded when they can. Also, I had nothing to do with this. I was literally about to head to sleep when they messaged me. I don't know why I'm getting accused of cheating when I had no activate role in their game. Addendum* Yes, technically they could've cheated without my knowledge so we don't know for sure. If it's found out for sure I will own up to that but right now I'm just being roped in by "assumed" guilt of association.

They'll share what they recorded when they can but they're massive files, and they're redoing the Easter egg right now to test steps they're unsure on. All I ask is that you leave me out of this. If it's revealed later that they cheated then fair enough. They're not content creators. 

You can also look at the game over screen that the game was over 7 hours and they were on round 50+. Here's the boss fight https://youtu.be/VnX8ang_dVs I don't think they would be on such a high round if they cheated.

I was just about to sleep and they messaged me that they had beat it. I had nothing to do with the hunt. I didn't even know what the step was exactly. They've gotten proven world's firsts before without cheating so I wouldn't just suddenly assume it's different this time.

Lastly, I accidentally deleted this video when trying to delete something else. I'm so tired and stressed from being harassed that I made that stupid mistake so have reposted.

Entire COD Zombies Story explained World at War to Black Ops 7 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MIPGAmtmCtk

snippet.description:
🔥Play War Thunder for FREE and get a massive bonus pack! PC, PlayStation and Xbox —  https://wtplay.link/thebacklogs 💥
WT Mobile — https://wtm.game/thebacklogswtm

Last time we attempted this, we got the run all the way to Sens Fortress before we were no longer able to progress. We covered a lot of side paths, but the main questline was unobtainable.
...or so I thought.
But after challenging the Dark Souls community to do better, we can now say with absolute certainty that Dark Souls 1 can be completely beaten without every aggoing an enemy.

Let me show you how it's done.

@illusorywall for teaching the Souls community about enemy detection mechanics.
